meta.title: Weight & Mass Converter — Convert Kilogram and More
meta.description: Free weight & mass converter for 10+ units including Kilogram, Gram, Milligram. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Kilograms, pounds, ounces, tonnes and more. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 10 weight & mass units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for weight & mass in this tool is **kg**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most weight & mass conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this weight & mass converter?
**A:** It uses 10 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Kilogram (kg), Gram (g), Milligram (mg), Metric Ton (t), Pound (lb), Ounce (oz), Stone (st), Carat (ct), US Ton (short) (ton (US)), UK Ton (long) (ton (UK)).
